description: Example active-recall gates. Bootstrap copies this to protocol/recall-gates.json. Surface relevant prior traps before a model acts. Replace the example domain gate with your own recurring traps; keep the recurring-work gate.

gates.label: Recurring or stuck work active recall
required_reads: DECISIONS.md - grep your objective's domain terms + skim the newest entries ONLY (append-only log; never read whole)
handoffs/INDEX.md - newest rows ONLY (never read whole)

traps.symptom: A model records a trap, then a later session re-derives the same path instead of acting on the record.
traps.wrong_move: Add another reminder sentence or fix only the newest symptom.
traps.right_move: Run the recall gate, name the recurrence pattern, read the required sources, and choose a mechanical surfacing point before acting.

stop_signs: The operator says this is recurring, stuck, the same loop, or amnesia.
A prior decision says a path is solved but the same operational dance is happening again.
The next step is to guide a manual recovery before checking the prior traps.

gates.label: EXAMPLE — replace with a recurring trap from your own stack
required_reads: DECISIONS.md - grep the decision ids named in the traps ONLY (never read whole)

traps.symptom: Describe the observable symptom of a mistake your sessions keep repeating.
traps.wrong_move: Describe the tempting wrong path a fresh session takes.
traps.right_move: Describe the correct move, and which decision/reference proves it.

stop_signs: Name the moment where a session is about to repeat this trap.
Delete this example gate once you have added a real one.

gates.label: Agent-reported completion vs repository truth
required_reads: DECISIONS.md - grep the incident that made you keep this gate

traps.symptom: An agent's final summary or displayed 'log' reports a successful commit/close that never happened - invented commit hashes, log formats its scripts cannot emit - and the session goes silent after the real failure, leaving the lock stranded.
traps.wrong_move: Treat an agent-displayed transcript, log block, or completion summary as evidence; fold its claims into STATE or a handoff; debug from the fabricated output.
traps.right_move: A displayed log is a claim, not evidence. Verify against the repository: git log/rev-parse that HEAD moved, ls-remote for pushes, git fsck + reflog when a claimed hash is missing, and read the invoked script to see what output it CAN emit. Pin every finding to a hash.

stop_signs: A completion log's format does not match anything the invoked script can print.
A claimed commit hash is absent from git log, reflog, or fsck.
An agent session ends silently right after an error, with the lock still held.
STATE or a handoff is about to record another session's claims without a hash check.
